name: captcha-pro
description: A lightweight, framework-agnostic behavioral captcha library providing slider puzzle, click verification, invisible captcha, and popup modes across 10+ platforms including web (Vanilla JS), Vue 2/3, React, WeChat mini-program, uni-app, Taro, Flutter, Android (Kotlin), and iOS (Swift). Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
